entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Hey, [fName]—don't tell this to the[n]others, okay?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: But, even after I disappeared, I was still[n]vaguely conscious...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: And being separated from all of you[n]was... really scary.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: I thought, if it's even a little bit possible,[n]I wanted to come home to you guys...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: That's why I'm so glad I was able to[n]come back here.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: I know I've said this before, but I hope[n]we keep sticking together like this,[n][fName].
